about: I'm Naphtali Sunday, a Web Developer, Data Analyst and MEAL Specialist with 6+ years of experience building web applications and data systems and leading capacity-building initiatives.

I have worked extensively on USAID/PEPFAR-funded health programmes across Northeast Nigeria, managing HIV case-management data in LAMIS and DHIS2, sustaining 99% data integrity and training 100+ professionals in data management and digital skills.
My work bridges technology and impact, from web-based restaurant systems to programme data that drives decisions in health, education and development.
